item.title: Japan Firms Secure Global Standard for AI-Era Photonic Networks
item.summary: KDDI Corporation, NTT, Inc., 1Finity Inc., NEC Corporation, Rakuten Mobile, Inc., Oki Electric Industry Co., Ltd., and Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. have jointly declared that an international standard for low-latency and energy-efficient networks designed to support the AI era has been officially approved by the International Telecommunication Union Telecommunication Standardization Sector (ITU-T) as of August […] The post Japan Firms Secure Global Standard for AI-Era Photonic Networks appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
